entities.definition: The visible tissue opening at the operative site remaining after the excised tissue has been removed, excluding retractors, instruments, and surrounding intact tissue.

false_claim.subject: resulting excision site
false_claim.text: After the excised tissue is removed, the resulting excision site is visibly closed across the same post-state frames before suturing begins.

rationale: The excision site is a unary postcondition state; both claims concern the same site and temporal scope, with only the open/closed predicate changed.

true_claim.subject: resulting excision site
true_claim.text: After the excised tissue is removed, the resulting excision site remains visibly open across the selected post-state frames before suturing begins.

entities.definition: The visible gallbladder tissue or specimen being placed into and retained within the specimen bag.
The visible specimen retrieval bag, including its visible boundary and opening, excluding surrounding tissue and instruments.

false_claim.subject: gallbladder
false_claim.text: After the specimen-bag opening is tightened, the gallbladder is visibly outside and spatially separate from the specimen bag across the same post-action frames.

rationale: Across the selected post-action frames, the same gallbladder and specimen bag are evaluated in the same temporal context. The paired claims differ only in the containment predicate.

true_claim.subject: gallbladder
true_claim.text: After the specimen-bag opening is tightened, the gallbladder remains visibly contained within the specimen bag across the selected post-action frames.

entities.definition: The visible distal working end of the hook instrument, excluding its shaft outside the operative field.
The visible distal working end of the grasper instrument, excluding its shaft outside the operative field.

false_claim.text: During 720.04–740.04 seconds of VID110, the center of the visible hook is above the center of the visible grasper in the image plane.

rationale: Across the approved evidence window, the same visible hook and grasper are compared by their image-plane centers. The matched claims differ only in the vertical relation predicate.

true_claim.text: During 720.04–740.04 seconds of VID110, the center of the visible hook is below the center of the visible grasper in the image plane.

entities.definition: The visible distal working end of the endoscopic dissection knife, excluding non-knife accessories and the surrounding tissue.
The visible distal working end of the forceps instrument, excluding the shaft outside the operative field and surrounding tissue.

false_claim.text: During the same evidence interval, the visible knife is located to the left of the visible forceps in the image plane.

rationale: Across the selected, author-confirmed evidence interval, the same visible knife and forceps are compared in the image plane. The matched claims differ only in the horizontal relation predicate.

true_claim.text: During the selected evidence interval, the visible knife is located to the right of the visible forceps in the image plane.
